name: P25 设备逐次续保记录

sources.sql:
SELECT r.id,r.con_xb,r.barcode,r.grade,r.begin_date,r.end_date,r.warranty,r.remark,r.isyb,r.state,
 CONCAT('fb_service:',r.id,':',COALESCE(r.barcode,'')) AS renewalSourceKey
 FROM (
 SELECT DISTINCT rn.barcode FROM (SELECT DISTINCT barcode FROM fb_service
 WHERE barcode IS NOT NULL AND barcode<>'' AND (:deviceSns='' OR FIND_IN_SET(barcode,:deviceSns))) rn
 STRAIGHT_JOIN fb_shipment_barcode sb ON sb.barcode=rn.barcode
 STRAIGHT_JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT s.packlist_id FROM (SELECT DISTINCT pc.contractNo FROM pm_project_group_relationship m
 JOIN pm_project_group g ON g.projectGroupCode=m.projectGroupCode
 JOIN (SELECT original.*,canonical.projectId AS canonicalProjectId
FROM pm_project original
JOIN (
  SELECT CAST(projectType AS BINARY) AS typeKey,CAST(projectCode AS BINARY) AS codeKey,
    MAX(projectId) AS projectId
  FROM pm_project
  GROUP BY CAST(projectType AS BINARY),CAST(projectCode AS BINARY)
) canonical ON canonical.typeKey <=> CAST(original.projectType AS BINARY)
  AND canonical.codeKey <=> CAST(original.projectCode AS BINARY)
JOIN pm_project current_project ON current_project.projectId=canonical.projectId
WHERE current_project.disabled=0 AND current_project.effectiveTo IS NULL
  AND original.disabled=0 AND original.effectiveTo IS NULL
  AND FIND_IN_SET(current_project.projectType,:projectTypes)
  AND (:projectIds='' OR FIND_IN_SET(canonical.projectId,:projectIds))) p ON p.projectCode=REPLACE(m.projectCode,'-his','') AND p.projectType=g.projectType
 JOIN pm_project_contract pc ON pc.projectGroupCode=g.projectGroupCode
 WHERE (:projectTypes='' OR FIND_IN_SET(p.projectType,:projectTypes))
 AND (:projectIds='' OR FIND_IN_SET(p.projectId,:projectIds))
 AND p.projectId=p.canonicalProjectId) pc STRAIGHT_JOIN fb_contract c ON c.contract_code=pc.contractNo STRAIGHT_JOIN fb_shipment s ON s.con_id=c.contract_id WHERE c.contract_type IN (0,11)) packages ON packages.packlist_id=sb.pack_id
 WHERE (sb.rma_no IS NULL OR sb.rma_no='' OR sb.rma_no='null')
 ) selected STRAIGHT_JOIN fb_service r ON r.barcode=selected.barcode
 WHERE :deviceSns='' OR FIND_IN_SET(r.barcode,:deviceSns)
